Vivo Los Trapenses

Neighbourhood shopping centre in Lo Barnechea, designed for local residents. Practical range of supermarket, services, food and some clothing stores.

Best for

  • Lo Barnechea residents
  • Quick local purchases
  • Everyday services

Not ideal for

  • Tourists
  • Those looking for wide variety or premium brands

Getting there

No direct metro access. Reached by car or bus.

Recommended time: 1 hour
